verdict.rationale: Databricks documents ingestion tooling (a connector-selection page for cloud object storage sources) and Auto Loader for incrementally/bulk processing new files as they arrive in cloud storage, which covers CSV/JSON/Parquet ingestion, but no evidence names a single specific command (e.g., COPY INTO) or shows a concrete one-line bulk-load example spanning all three formats. Missing for 10: explicit single documented command syntax for bulk-loading CSV/JSON/Parquet, and independent/hands-on confirmation of ease-of-use.
